one_liner: API v5 for Pins/Boards, ads management/reporting, catalogs, conversions, and analytics.
access_notes: Create/login to a Business account, accept Developer Terms, request Trial (reviewed), then upgrade to Standard (additional review incl. demo video).
mcp_notes: Official Pinterest MCP Server provided by Pinterest: https://developer.pinterest.com/about-pinterest-mcp/
blocker_notes: Production-scale features and higher rate limits require Pinterest app review; some features may need account-team enablement.

evidence.quote: Login or create a business account… Go to My apps and click through to accept our Developer Terms… Submit your request for trial access. Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
If approved for API use, your app receives Trial access… we recommend upgrading to Standard access… Prepare a video recording of your app… Submit your request.
Use Sandbox to test your integration… entities in your Sandbox environment are separate from entities in your production environment.
Prompt the user… to https://www.pinterest.com/oauth/… exchange the code for an access token… include the access token… Authorization: Bearer {your_token}.
This repository contains OpenAPI (version 3.0.3) descriptions for Pinterest’s REST API.
Create a subscription… Specify the callback URL via the webhook_url field… Pinterest delivers lead data to subscribers… Encryption: … AES-256-GCM.

_trail.quote: "Pinterest MCP Server brings the power of Pinterest data directly into the AI assistants, copilots, and agentic workflows you already use."

_reconciled.reason: mcp was set to official but mcp_notes were empty; added the official Pinterest MCP Server reference and URL to align with mcp=official.
